related_questions.question: How do you calculate pretax annual income?
related_questions.snippet: How to calculate annual income. To calculate an annual salary, multiply the gross pay (before tax deductions) by the number of pay periods per year. For example, if an employee earns $1,500 per week, the individual's annual income would be 1,500 x 52 = $78,000.

related_questions.question: How do you calculate annual income before taxes?
related_questions.snippet: If you receive a monthly paycheck, multiply the amount you got paid via your last paycheck by 12. If you receive a weekly paycheck, multiply the amount you got paid by 52. If you get paid hourly, multiply the number of hours you worked during a given year by your hourly rate to determine your gross annual income .
